rationale: Class 1 missing-rate review. The flagged extracted PRIVATE_CREDIT cells have neither interest_rate nor basis_spread, but the raw March 31, 2026 schedule explicitly prints fixed PIK interest rates for affected debt rows, including two Quick Commerce loans at 6.00% and two Sylva loans at 15.00%. A PIK coupon is rate data and should populate the platform's all-in interest_rate field; leaving both rate fields blank is therefore a source-grounded extraction gap. Some other flagged loans may have genuinely undisclosed coupons, but that does not negate the confirmed defects in this aggregate nine-row flag.
